These compounds are likely acting as modulators or inhibitors of HCAAT, as they are associated with the transport of cationic amino acids. The presence of multiple pathways suggests that Santolina triene may exert its effects through different mechanisms, potentially influencing HCAAT in a complex manner. The evidence supports the hypothesis that Santolina triene could interact with HCAAT, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated.
